data.text: REST (Representational State Transfer) is an architectural style for APIs using HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) and stateless communication.
REST principles: stateless, client-server, cacheable, uniform interface, layered system. Use HTTP methods correctly. Return appropriate status codes.
